insolation.def: Incoming solar radiation: the Sun's energy reaching an area, in watts per square meter (W/m²). It is greatest where sunlight strikes most directly, near the equator.

axial-tilt.def: The tilt of Earth's axis, about 23.5°, which keeps pointing the same way as Earth orbits the Sun. It causes the seasons: the hemisphere tilted toward the Sun has summer.

albedo.def: The share of incoming sunlight a surface reflects. Snow and ice have a high albedo; open ocean and forest have a low albedo and absorb more energy.
